name: nextjs-degenff
description: Next.js app built from a git repo with tent's stock Dockerfile (auto-detects pnpm/yarn/npm). Mirrors the degenff deployment pattern.

git_repo.description: https URL of the git repo (e.g. https://github.com/you/site.git). For private repos, embed a deploy-token in the URL.

git_ref.description: branch, tag, or commit sha to deploy.

env_file_url.description: optional URL to a raw .env file (gist, private bucket, etc). Fetched at deploy time and mounted into the container as /app/.env.production.
